transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Mr. Sharma, thank you for calling Priority Bank Line. My name is Priya.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Please note this call is being recorded for quality and training purposes.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: To proceed with your card services, please verify your date of birth and the last 4 digits of your card.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Yes, date of birth is 15th August 1984, and card last four digits are 4581.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: My card was declined in Munich this morning. Card unblock karane ke kitne charges lagenge? Fees kya lagega?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Sir, unblock charges are 250 rupees, but agar aapka annual spend 1 lakh se upar hai toh unblock charges waive ho jayenge with zero charges.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Acha fee waive ho jayega. But card kab tak unblock hoga? What is the TAT, kitna time lagega?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Aapka card 24 working hours ke andar unblock ho jayega, and request raise hone par aur complete hone par SMS notification bhi milega.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Great, please unblock the international travel lock on this card immediately.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I have submitted the unblock request. In case of any further queries, our grievance escalation window is always available for you. Have a great day!
